clips.title: The story
paras: These intercepted papers were carried by a Scarlet Crusade messenger at the Crusade's camp near Deathknell. Containing orders for the Crusade's field commanders across Tirisfal Glades, they provide the Forsaken with the exact military intelligence needed to target the Crusade's regional leadership.

The courier Meven Korgal carried these documents at the Crusade's encampment southeast of Deathknell. Issued by order of the Highlord, the directives are addressed to the captains of the Crusade's Tirisfal Regional Command: Captain Perrine is to further fortify the southwest tower and gather information on the undead in Brill, Captain Vachon to crush undead movement near the northern tower, and Captain Melrose to watch the borders of the Plaguelands. The documents reveal the names, posts, and orders of Scarlet field officers stationed across Tirisfal Glades, turning an otherwise routine courier run into a catastrophic intelligence breach for the zealots.

Executor Arren swiftly recognized that local forces in Deathknell could not exploit the full breadth of the intelligence. Instead, the captured dossier serves as a newly awakened Forsaken's passport out of Deathknell. Carried northeast past Cold Hearth Manor into Brill, the documents are handed directly to Executor Zygand outside the Brill Town Hall. With these orders in hand, the Forsaken military leadership plans swift decapitation strikes against Scarlet commanders entrenched across the Glades.
